mapper.select: SELECT el.*, COALESCE(eu.username, uu.username) AS executor_name, ou.username AS owner_name FROM execution_log el LEFT JOIN user ou ON ou.id = el.owner_id LEFT JOIN user eu ON eu.id = el.executor_id LEFT JOIN user uu ON uu.id = el.user_id WHERE el.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO execution_log (flow_id, flow_name, user_id, app_id, flow_snapshot_id, input_params, execute_type, source, owner_id, executor_id, status, start_time, end_time, duration, error_message, stop_type) VALUES (#{flowId}, #{flowName}, #{userId}, #{appId}, #{flowSnapshotId}, #{inputParams}, #{executeType}, #{source}, #{ownerId}, #{executorId}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{duration}, #{errorMessage}, #{stopType})
